scope: Public software artifact download and local package metadata inspection only; no installation, execution, native loading or account data access.

discovery.note: Unsubstantiated child statements about DockerHub index/architecture/layer mappings were retracted and are not used as evidence.

limits: The matching manifest MD5 corroborates the recorded package metadata; it is not cryptographic publisher authentication or proof that every installed software byte matches this downloaded artifact.
The original main is now confirmed from package bytes; prior snapshots reporting it unknown remain historical evidence.
No claim is made that the archived bootstrap entry is ordinary readable JavaScript or independently loadable in generic Node.
The earlier release-address HTTP 403 and this distinct publisher-listed beta artifact HTTP 206 are different endpoint observations, not a claim of universal availability.
QQ host coupling, native API signatures, initialization, events and all personal-account features still require isolated runtime validation.
